visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white crop top and grey flared denim jeans, stands on a wooden platform outdoors at night. She adjusts white-rimmed sunglasses while looking at the camera. Behind her is a modern building with warm interior lighting and several bystanders walking by. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a brightly lit area with multiple digital screens. She puts on large black headphones and sways to an unseen rhythm. One screen displays a cinematic mountain landscape, and a neon 'gamania' sign glows in the background. (3) She walks to a display board titled 'GAMA 30 NIGHT OUT' and points at twenty small, colorful humanoid 'Little Orange Man' figures. She then handles various white and heart-shaped sunglasses at a prop station with pink and purple neon accents. (4) She enters a mirrored photobooth area and poses with her fingers in a peace sign. A close-up shows a hand holding a printed photostrip featuring two shots of her posing in the booth. (5) She stands before a series of circular convex mirrors mounted on a wall. The mirrors reflect her multiple times as she moves her head and smiles. (6) She stands at a kiosk with a microphone, looking at her smartphone while speaking. A large screen displays an animated red-haired girl in a cape. (7) She moves to a self-serve bar wall with taps numbered 12 to 16. She interacts with a digital screen above tap 16 and pulls the lever to dispense a dark red liquid into a clear plastic cup. (8) She takes a sip of the red drink, smiles at the camera, and poses with the cup. She then picks up a brown glass beer bottle labeled 'GAMA BEER'. (9) A second woman wearing a similar light-colored crop top joins her. They toast their drinks and laugh together in front of the neon 'gamania' sign. (10) She stands in front of a purple 'GAMA 30 NIGHT OUT' backdrop with many small photos pinned to it. She holds a cup and a beer bottle while speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face.
